The '''Glee Anselm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]].
